newsitem.title: USA: NY physical coffee - futures rally stalls business.
newsitem.headline: NY physical coffee - futures rally stalls business.

text.p: Activity on the New York physical coffee market came to a standstill, with roasters stepping aside after nearby futures prices rallied some 15 percent on the week, traders said.
CSCE May's hefty 30-cent premium to second-month July also soured roasters' appetite for the market, as producers remained eager to price against the spot contract, they said. And
sky-high spot differentials for most mild coffees compounded roasters' frustrations.

"It is expensive and getting worse," one trader said. "Nobody is doing anything. Everyone is just waiting for May to go off the board, so physical activity over the next two weeks is going to be dull."
The high cost of coffee prompted leading roaster Folgers Coffee Co to raise by 20 cents the list price on its standard 13-ounce cans of ground regular and decaffeinated coffees early this week.
The increase, which was to take effect immediately, was their third price hike in the last two months, bringing the total rise to 80 cents -- about a 35 percent -- a can.
